headline: Curated databases tie biomolecular structures to experimental binding and specificity
label: Curated Biomolecular Structure Resources
summary: Recent releases of ARIEL, SAbDab2, and the TCR Motif Atlas add experimentally anchored affinity and benchmark-ready annotation to structural and specificity…
synthesis: The dominant thread is curated resources that attach experimental annotation to biomolecular structures or sequence-level specificity data. ARIEL pairs 278 nonredundant RNA-ligand complexes with experimental Kd values spanning nine orders of magnitude, and SAbDab2 provides antibody structures with ML-grade quality and versioned train/test splits. The TCR Motif Atlas catalogs TCR specificity profiles for viral, cancer, and autoimmune epitopes with an interactive construction tool. What is new is the emphasis on benchmark-ready partitioning and binding-affinity annotation attached to structures. The AlphaFold 3 study applies structure prediction to more than 9000 TCRs across over 1000 epitopes, reporting median AUCs of 0.81-0.92. DeepPhage is a related but distinct open-source tool for statistical analysis of phage display NGS data to identify Eu3+-binding peptides.
